subject: Re: delivery slot
text: You're right, the sudden parking change messed everything up. I know you only just started working with us, so seeing a last-minute switch after all that planning must have felt random. It happened because the building manager pulled the loading bay for maintenance an hour before delivery. I've already asked for a different entrance, and the crew will arrive early to unpack outside if needed. I'll text you the second I have a confirmed time. Sorry it landed on your first week—this is my fault, not yours.
